And take a blue block with the long side facing you and place it on top of the green block so that the centers of the two longer blocks are aligned. So you have kind of a cross thing on top and the red block at the bottom in the bottom left corner. So it goes like this, this, and this. Same thing we did before. Yeah.

Message 2: I am so sorry that was my bad. Take the structure you have built and just put it in the bottom right, not the bottom left. My bad. This square. Bottom right.
